reason: A columns prop, the most tiles in a row, so four providers stand two and two and not three and one; and bare, without its card, for a page whose own title says what the card's would.
A plain variant with no fill, and a trigger that takes Text's size and weight, so a page keeps one body style; with fitContent it no longer wraps in a box that shrinks to fit.

In the dropzone, Choose files is underlined words in its line, as a link in a sentence, not an outline button: the dropzone is already the place to act. Made taller by a minHeight on the upload, its icon and line stay together in its middle.

A one-line description is cut at the row's edge: in Connect API key a long region ran out of its tile. And ItemGrid's columns, so many tiles a row from a small window up: seven places stand three, three and one.
New: what a dictation hears is written in the prompt input's text as it is heard, each word flown up from the voice's field in the bar and faded in where it lands.
Its grade and the other voice's are exported: the voice's hill is drawn in the same light.
New: the voice drawn as the system's dither rising from the card's foot, a hill with drifting humps, in the field's place.

A voice is drawn as the hill (prompt-input-voice-hill.ts) in the field's place, on a canvas that reaches from the bar's foot to its top (in a compact card, from the card's foot). And timed={false} on PromptInputVoice leaves the running time out, where the page keeps its own. And what a dictation hears is drawn in the text word by word (prompt-input-heard.tsx), in place of the lighter words after it. A voice's mute shows the microphone struck through while it is off, named Unmute, with no held fill; and its close is a words button, a keyboard and Type instead, not an X.
A tooltip prop on the trigger, drawn as Button's, for a select among a bar's tools: a Tooltip wrapped round it never opened.
The icon button's sizes under Button's names and at Button's heights (its sm was Button's xs), and a tooltip as Button's, its name by default.
speechButton.unmute, the name of a voice's mute while it is off; and voice.close as Type instead, for the words button that gives the text back.
The filled forms of the message and pause icons, for a header whose icons are filled. And MicOffIcon and KeyboardIcon, for a voice's mute and its Type instead.
New: the small squares that carry a heard word from the voice's field to its place in the text, for the prompt input's dictation and the interview's composer.
